reused_why: the runs that carry over as their own 16K run, listed as `reused` so driver.py --dry-run counts them as not played. A run whose prompt never passed 16,384 before its final call would behave the same at 16,384: the trigger reads the last agent call's exact prompt_tokens and compacts before the next call, so its calls and record would be the same up to sampling. Each lists its counted record's file and run dir in the 32K set's folder (repo-relative), and prompt_before_final_call (the largest agent turn prompt before the final one)
reruns: a run that fails or times out (end error, overflow, crash or timeout, or a Jev error marked rerun) is played again, up to four tries, and the last play stands. A run that fails on every try is reported as failed and left out of every measure, with its pairs. A run that reaches the turn limit (max turns) is a finished run and is kept
